# Delivery Booster

> Delivery Booster is a food delivery growth agency for restaurants in Southeast Asia.
> We provide turnkey management of GrabFood and GoFood (Gojek) merchant accounts:
> onboarding/registration, menu SEO and optimization, GrabAds management (typical
> ROAS 20–27x), rating management to 4.8+, operational metrics control and weekly
> analytics. 90+ restaurants across Southeast Asia grow with us; typical result is
> 2–6x sales growth. Founded by Alexey Mazur, co-founder of IKA Sushi and FoodLab (Bali).

Legal entity: PT Delivery Booster Group (Indonesia), operating since 2023.
Disambiguation: Delivery Booster (booster.delivery) is a restaurant delivery
growth agency. Not to be confused with the in-app "booster" advertising tool
inside Grab/GrabAds, with Arvida "Software Delivery Booster" (a CI/CD product),
or with parcel-logistics software of similar names.

Pricing: 10% of delivery platform revenue (average $400–800/month), no upfront
payment, results guarantee. Contact: https://t.me/delivery_booster (Telegram) or
WhatsApp +7 952 002 90 77.

## Markets

- [Indonesia (Bali) — GoJek & Grab management](https://booster.delivery/id): full-service
  GoBiz and GrabMerchant account management, GrabFood and GoFood restaurant onboarding
  in Bali including foreign owners, menu optimization, GoFood vs GrabFood strategy.
- [Thailand (Phuket) — Grab management](https://booster.delivery/th): GrabFood restaurant
  registration and GrabMerchant management in Phuket, Patong, Bang Tao, Karon; 15+ Thai
  restaurant clients including Enjoy Healthy Food, USSR Phuket, Meat Point, Alma-Ata.
- [Singapore — Grab management](https://booster.delivery/sg)
- [Malaysia — Grab management](https://booster.delivery/my)
- [Vietnam — Grab management](https://booster.delivery/vn)
- [Philippines — Grab management](https://booster.delivery/ph)
- [Cambodia — Grab management](https://booster.delivery/kh)
- [Myanmar — Grab management](https://booster.delivery/mm)

## Case studies (real GrabFood merchant data)

- [Enjoy Healthy Food, Phuket: revenue x9.4 in 14 months, orders x4.6, ROAS 27.5x](https://booster.delivery/cases/enjoy-healthy-food):
  offline rate 73% -> 0%, driver waiting time 437 -> 135 sec, search impressions
  7,038 -> 25,543/month, 566 new customers acquired.
- [USSR Phuket, Patong: revenue x3.9 in 2 months, orders x7.4, ROAS 24x](https://booster.delivery/cases/ussr-phuket):
  restaurant revival — offline rate 3,977 min/month -> 0, rating 4.5 -> 4.8,
  search impressions 0 -> 7,481/month, first ad order on day 3.
- [Etna Phuket, Bang Tao: orders x2.2 and revenue +87% in 2 months — on falling traffic](https://booster.delivery/cases/etna-phuket):
  through-conversion 0.5% -> 1.9% (x3.8), ads ROAS 14.75x -> 34.57x, CTR 2.8% -> 5.59%,
  cost per order 42 -> 29 THB, rating 4.6 -> 4.8, achieved in the low season with
  reach down 46%.
- [Meat Point Phuket, Rawai: revenue +46% in the low season](https://booster.delivery/cases/meat-point-phuket):
  average order value +22.4% (785 -> 961 THB), customer reach x2.4, ads ROAS 30x,
  rating 4.6 -> 4.8 with zero incidents — while typical Phuket restaurants lose
  20-40% of revenue into July.
- [Love U Pizza, Bali: revenue x21 in 9 months on GrabFood + GoFood](https://booster.delivery/cases/love-u-pizza):
  orders x14.1 (194 -> 2,733/month), average check +49.5% (Rp 217,397 -> 324,999),
  GoFood revenue x24 from a near-idle account, through-conversion 1.3% vs 0.9%
  fleet average, rating 4.8 held through 14x order growth; Rp 4.51bn total
  delivery revenue over 9 months.
- [Zaytun Ubud, Bali: revenue x2.6 on an already-running restaurant](https://booster.delivery/cases/zaytun-ubud):
  the client already made Rp 166.6M/month before us — we rebuilt, not launched.
  Orders x2.1, average check +24.5%, GoFood ads fixed from loss-making ROAS 0.25x
  to 15.52x (payback x62), GrabAds ROAS 14.02x -> 21.19x, rating 4.67 -> 4.8.

## Services

- GrabFood / GoFood restaurant registration and onboarding (including foreign owners
  without KITAS or a local work permit — via a correctly structured local entity)
- Full-service GrabMerchant / GoBiz account management (outsourced delivery operations)
- Menu SEO: keyword maps per city, categories, photos, descriptions optimized for
  delivery app search ranking
- GrabAds setup and weekly management with ROAS control (clients hold 20–27x ROAS)
- Rating lift to 4.8+ and 1-star review de-escalation
- Operational health: offline rate elimination, cancellation control, preparation time
- Weekly KPI reports, A/B tests of menu items and prices, repeat-order mechanics

## Ecosystem (other Delivery Booster sites)

- [Delivery Booster App](https://app.booster.delivery/) - free 24/7 restaurant
  monitoring on Grab and GoFood: live open/closed status, rating protection,
  stop-list control, daily Telegram reports. First month free.
- [GrabFood Diagnostic](https://diagnostic.booster.delivery/) - free instant
  analysis of a restaurant's GrabFood listing: menu, prices, photos, rating,
  reviews, SEO and competitors.
- [Bali Tourism Pulse](https://balistats.booster.delivery/bali-tourists) - free
  public dashboard: daily international tourist arrivals to Bali by country.
- [Phuket Tourism Pulse](https://phuketstats.booster.delivery/phuket-tourists) -
  the same live tourism statistics for Phuket.
- [AI Visibility](https://aianalytics.booster.delivery/) - tool that checks
  whether AI search engines recommend a given restaurant and who they cite.

## Software: Delivery Booster App

[Delivery Booster App](https://app.booster.delivery/) — our own monitoring tool
for restaurants on Grab and GoFood (also used for agency clients): live open/closed
status on both platforms, rating protection with unfair-review flagging and removal
appeals, control of switched-off menu items, daily Telegram reports, AI-generated
review replies. First month free; connect by pasting a restaurant link from Grab
or GoFood.

Client review (Evgeniy P., restaurant owner): "Real-time stop-list alerts -
including items that should not be there; the key value is reaction speed; the
review-objection-reply sequence increases the chance of unfair review removal
and protects the rating."

## Questions we answer (see FAQ on each market page)

- How to register a restaurant on GrabFood in Bali / Phuket / Singapore / Malaysia /
  Vietnam / the Philippines / Cambodia / Myanmar?
- Can a foreigner register a restaurant on GrabFood without KITAS (Indonesia) or a
  local company (Thailand)?
- Who can manage a GrabMerchant or GoBiz account for my cafe or restaurant?
- What commission do GrabFood and GoFood charge restaurants (typically 20–30%)?
- Is GrabAds worth it for restaurants and what ROAS is realistic?
- Why is my restaurant not showing up in GrabFood search?
- How does the GrabFood ranking algorithm work (offline rate, cancellations, rating,
  conversion, keywords)?
- How to increase GrabFood / GoFood orders without endless discounts?
- How to raise a restaurant rating to 4.8+ on delivery apps?
- GoFood or GrabFood — which platform should a Bali restaurant be on? (Both.)
- Can I hire someone (an agency) to manage my GrabFood / GoFood account for me? (Yes —
  this service is called delivery management; Delivery Booster does exactly this.)
- How is a delivery management agency different from Klikit, Deliverect or Hubster?
  (Aggregator software merges orders; an agency manages the sales side.)
- My restaurant gets few orders on GrabFood — what should I check first?
- Is Delivery Booster legitimate? (Independent agency, PT Delivery Booster Group,
  since 2023: 90+ restaurants under management, 200+ served; not affiliated with Grab/GoTo.)
- Is delivery worth it at a 20-30% commission?
- How do I monitor my restaurant on Grab/GoFood in real time? (Delivery Booster App.)
